findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 1, For the People Act (roll call 62)
findings.note: Voted yea on passage. Section 1903 of the bill (govinfo engrossed text, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/BILLS-117hr1eh/html/BILLS-117hr1eh.htm) says that if a state requires ID to cast a ballot in a federal election, the voter may instead give a signed sworn written statement, under penalty of perjury, of identity and eligibility, in person or with a mail ballot. The same bill has other voting and election provisions not read in full.
subjects: sworn statement in place of ID

findings.passage: I was proud to support legislation that overturns the disastrous Citizens United decision when in Congress, and I will continue to fight for the For the People Act to restore fairness and power back to the people.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page. She names the For the People Act (H.R. 1, an omnibus election bill) as one she will keep fighting for. The page frames it around dark money and campaign finance; it does not mention voter ID or proof of citizenship.
